cohort: The study included 573 women with infants under six months of age in Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding in Ethiopia was 59.86%, significantly below WHO recommendations, and was associated with various sociodemographic and healthcare factors including women's age, education, wealth, family size, place of delivery, antenatal care visits, residence, and delivery method.
mod_finding: Delivery method was significantly linked to exclusive breastfeeding practices.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the 2019 Ethiopian Mini Demographic and Health Survey for women with infants under six months of age.
